# Release 2026-10-25

## What Changed

Release Notes 2026 10 25 Monitor the release status by regions at AKS Release Tracker. This release is titled v20261025 . Announcements of upcoming changes and retirements Starting on June 1, 2027, AKS automatically upgrades any cluster that stays on an unsupported Kubernetes version after its 60 day platform support grace period ends. What’s changing: AKS will be able to automatically initiate upgrades to help keep clusters supported, secure, and aligned with platform lifecycle requirements. How to prepare now: Review upgrade channels, maintenance windows, and workload readiness so your clusters can absorb automated upgrade events with minimal disruption. See: Platform initiated upgrades. Starting with Kubernetes 1.38, node pools that use the Ubuntu OS SKU will default to Ubuntu 26.04. To continue using Ubuntu 24.04 on Kubernetes 1.38, specify the Ubuntu2404 OS SKU. For more information, see Upgrade the OS version for your AKS node pools. Release notes Kubernetes versions Kubernetes version 1.37 is now generally available and designated as a Long Term Support (LTS) version. Kubernetes 1.36 is now the default version for new clusters. Kubernetes patch versions 1.37.1, 1.36.5, 1....
